args.prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation sheet of six unique ink-blob characters. Use the first two original benchmarks for modeled dark charcoal-plum goo face, soft tactile clay and white sclera with separate red iris and black pupil.  Crew: Full-Suit Quarantine. ivory pearl rubber full-body coveralls with deep teal taped seams, pale blue filter pods, soft teal gloves and rounded ivory face rims. Hazard is fictional airborne contamination. All six MUST wear a convincing full protective coverall that clearly encloses the whole round blob body from shoulders through belly to a broad low hem. Colorful fabric or rubber chest and belly are continuous with the suit sides, with an obvious long front seam, rounded shoulders, fitted sleeves and seam tape. Only the expressive dark-ink face in an open hood ring, plus two little dark ink nubs or tiny ink feet peeking from under the hem, show through. No long legs or human proportions. Thick suit gloves on at least four, including distinct articulated mitten forms. Full wrapped body suit, not bare purple bellies with a collar. Open clear visors raised above eyes when present. Carefully match six DIFFERENT mouth shapes, mostly CLOSED. Never repeat the stock giant open grin. Small asymmetric face poses, dark ink lips, no teeth glued outside. Two female-read designs in positions 2 and 5. Each figure carries its own simple prop and is usable by itself. Six separate full silhouettes in a landscape 1536x1024 transparent PNG, three columns by two rows, genuinely alpha-zero background. Generous gutters and outer margins. No text, floor, matte, shadow disc, overlap, or shared objects. Top row Intake Detail, bottom row Isolation Detail. Row-major directions:
1. Male-read intake lead with small teal-cornered blank slate. broad rounded silhouette, gentle CLOSED crescent smile, relaxed lids.
2. Female-read triage specialist with pale blue handheld thermometer. tall tapered silhouette, small CLOSED pursed skeptical lips, one high eyebrow.
3. Male-read air kit carrier with spare round teal filter pod. squat rounded silhouette, tiny worried open oval mouth with no visible teeth, wide uneven eyes.
4. Male-read boundary lead with short teal radio. wide boxy silhouette, straight CLOSED deadpan mouth and heavy half-lids.
5. Female-read screen operator with compact ivory Hypernormalization Screen with teal casing. lean curved silhouette, asymmetric CLOSED determined smirk and sideways eyes.
6. Male-read sample custodian with small sealed clear card sleeve. scalloped pear silhouette, tight uneven grimace with dark lips and no exposed teeth.
All six distinct full-suit silhouettes and glove poses at thumbnail size. Keep suits unmistakably covering the entire bodies. Transparent background.
